{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-2l9m","title":"Confessions rate limit and sender keyed on spoofable SenML bn","description":"File: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/confessions.py
Perspective: security (also robustness)

Spec 18.10.3 REQUIRED rate limit is 1 POST / 30s and 12 / hour per
node IID, to prevent spam. Rate limiting "uses per-node IID (not
OSCORE context)".

render_post gets source_iid from _extract_source_iid() (lines 62-69,
469-471): the SenML base name urn:dev:mac:<token>: is taken as the
node IID. There is no bind to CoAP source, OSCORE kid, or signature.
bn is attacker-controlled. The same token is stored as sender when
anonymous is false (lines 489, 530).

Evidence:
- 20 POSTs with distinct bn IIDs in one second all return 2.01
- anonymous=0 with bn of another node stores source=that IID and
  GET /confessions/{id} includes sender
- _request_times grows one list per spoofed IID and is only pruned
  when that key is seen again (_prune_old_requests)

Impact: the tightest LICHEN rate limit is honor-system; spam is
unlimited; the rate table is an unbounded RAM DoS; non-anonymous
posts impersonate any IID.

Acceptance: rate-limit key MUST be an authenticated identifier
(IPv6 source IID and/or OSCORE identity when present). Client
supplied sender/bn MUST NOT create a distinct quota bucket or a
displayed sender unless it matches that identity. Stale rate
buckets MUST be reaped without waiting for that key to return.
